column1: # Skill catalog, read by install.sh for the picker and the presets.
# Columns: name <TAB> group <TAB> presets <TAB> one-line blurb
# The blurb here is for a person choosing what to install. The `description`
# in each SKILL.md is a different thing: it's what the agent matches against
# to decide when to load the skill. Don't merge them.
# presets: comma-separated. `core` is what install.sh recommends by default.

column4: The whole style guide compressed to one page, plus the 597-entry word list. Start here.
Audits a doc you already have and reports findings ranked by what they cost the reader.
Active voice, tense, person, capitalization, abbreviations, plurals, possessives.
Serial commas, em dashes, hyphens and compounds, colons, quotes, slashes.
Headings, lists, tables, procedures, notices, link text.
Numbers, dates, units, math, images and alt text, bold vs italic vs code font.
Code font, samples, CLI syntax, placeholders, UI elements, API reference, example data.
Accessibility and inclusive language, including terms embedded in code.
Reviewing someone else's change: the standard, what to look for, speed, comments, pushback.
Getting your own change reviewed: small changes, splitting, descriptions, taking feedback.
